blocks.text: This Contract Franchise Ordinance is made under and in conformity with the laws of the State of Kansas. No such Contract Franchise Ordinance shall be effective until the ordinance granting the same has been adopted as provided by law. (Ord. 18894 § 17, 6-12-07.)
